decisive_items: Nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots
response.rationale: Nodular lumbosacral nerve root enhancement with CSF blasts is diagnostic of leptomeningeal disease; leukemia cutis indicates the underlying leukemic etiology. ALL is over-specific without lineage support.

rejected.why: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia is not supported; blasts and leukemia cutis indicate leukemia but no lineage evidence.
